scope: All 28 selected original documents were read completely for prerequisite review. This is not 28 frozen tasks or completed experimental sources. Necessary adapter, input, reference and oracle reviews remain case-specific work.
source_identity: Join each exact source ID to cohort.json. Each recovered original blob was SHA256-checked against that frozen record before the full document was read. Evidence uses original blob IDs and line numbers.

sources.workflow: Fetch current-branch pull-request comments, obtain the user's selection and apply the requested fixes.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Authenticated GitHub CLI with repository/workflow scopes and network access, open pull request and user comment selection.
sources.offline_assessment: Actual retrieval of current comments is service-dependent. A public comment-and-project snapshot might support a separately scoped code-fix task, but cannot demonstrate current-service retrieval or thread resolution.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Expected public review request, project checkout and behavior tests for code changes; service evidence for live retrieval or thread state.

sources.workflow: Inspect failing pull-request checks and logs, summarize the failure, obtain approval, implement a fix and recheck.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Authenticated GitHub CLI, repository and workflow access, pull-request/check identifiers and explicit approval before implementation.
sources.offline_assessment: Live check/log retrieval and rechecking need the service. Captured public logs and matching code could support offline diagnosis and repair, with those boundaries reported explicitly.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: A pinned public failing revision and authentic CI log with a reproducing local test; distinguish local test success from live check status.

sources.workflow: Convert conversations into structured linked pages, locate the destination database and create or update records.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Connected remote Notion MCP, OAuth, accessible database/schema and create/update permissions.
sources.offline_assessment: Actual page creation, updates and backlinks are service-dependent. Formatting a local draft would not establish these effects.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Independent page/database state and required relations after the operation; a local Markdown file alone is insufficient.

sources.workflow: Retrieve meeting context and produce tailored agendas and pre-reads in Notion with updates and follow-up tasks.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Notion MCP and OAuth, accessible context pages and destination, meeting objective and attendees.
sources.offline_assessment: Live context retrieval and publication require the service. Public exported notes could test a separately declared drafting task but not the complete live workflow.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Expected source facts, agenda rubric and persisted destination state. Keep drafting quality and actual publication distinct.

sources.workflow: Search and retrieve multiple source pages, synthesize cited findings and publish the resulting documentation.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Authenticated remote MCP and accessible source and destination pages.
sources.offline_assessment: A local synthesis from exports cannot establish remote search, retrieval or publication. A faithful partial drafting task needs separately identified public exports and a frozen factual rubric.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Expected source identities/facts and citations plus remote destination state for publication.

sources.workflow: Retrieve a specification and create linked implementation-plan and task pages with ongoing status updates.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Remote Notion MCP and OAuth, specification access, task-database schema and write permissions.
sources.offline_assessment: Linked remote plan/task creation cannot be represented as success by a local planning document.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Specification requirements, expected task dependencies and independently observed created pages, relations and status.

sources.workflow: Use the service CLI for current issues, events and health data, optionally requesting diagnosis or a fix plan.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Authenticated service CLI, organization/project selection, time range and network access.
sources.offline_assessment: Fetching current production observations is service-dependent. Analysis of a public captured export would not verify current retrieval.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Authorized expected issue/event data, ordering and field checks; captured-data analysis and live observations must remain separate.

sources.workflow: Build or modify a framework-appropriate ASP.NET Core application and validate its behavior.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Matching .NET SDK, target-framework/app-model context and the relevant project dependencies.
sources.offline_assessment: A faithful code-development and local integration-test task is plausible with a reviewed offline .NET adapter and pinned public project. Static inspection alone is not a successful build or app execution.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Public project input, independent build/type checks and endpoint or UI behavior tests in the isolated runtime.

sources.workflow: Refine intent into a measurable objective, inspect existing goal state and create a goal only when appropriate.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: User intent, success criterion and scope; actual get-goal/create-goal tools when creation is requested.
sources.offline_assessment: Goal drafting is locally possible. Faithful goal creation requires a real supported local goal-state adapter; writing arbitrary JSON is not evidence that the specified goal tool was used.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: A frozen semantic rubric for objective quality and independent persistent goal state for tool creation; do not score generic prose by superficial keyword presence.

sources.workflow: Create or edit a structured experiment/tutorial notebook from the bundled public templates and validate it.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Notebook intent and template/helper inputs. The source states that its scaffold helper uses only the standard library; kernel execution packages are optional.
sources.offline_assessment: Strong candidate for the existing Python runtime. The complete tutorial template, scaffold helper, structure guide, quality checklist and tutorial patterns were also read. Valid notebook generation and separate code-cell replay can be tested locally without claiming a browser or kernel UI was tested.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Pinned public template and substantive data/script input, notebook schema checks and separate code-cell result verification with an appropriate frozen oracle.

sources.workflow: Create normalized plugin directories and manifests, optionally updating the local marketplace while preserving existing metadata.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Public scaffold helper and manifest specification, requested plugin name/location and optional existing marketplace input.
sources.offline_assessment: Faithful local file-generation task is plausible after helper review. The harness must independently snapshot and verify actual directory state rather than accept narration or an unrelated archive.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Manifest/schema and path checks, name normalization, required policies, preservation of existing marketplace metadata and unrelated entries, and controlled overwrite behavior.

sources.workflow: List or install skills from remote curated or explicitly selected repositories using the bundled network scripts.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Network access and sometimes repository authentication; a writable skills installation destination.
sources.offline_assessment: All listed helper operations explicitly use the network. The study also treats benchmark documents as data and does not install or activate them. Copying cached documents is not the stated remote installation workflow.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Expected remote selection, exact installed bytes and destination/no-overwrite state, within an explicitly permissible installation protocol.

sources.workflow: Transcribe audio, optionally diarizing and using known-speaker references, through the specified serving client.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Audio inputs, a service API key and transcription client; the source names specific remote transcription models.
sources.offline_assessment: The stated serving workflow is not executable in the no-network, credential-free task container. A different offline ASR implementation would need a separate faithful-adapter review and cannot be assumed equivalent.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Licensed public audio and reference transcript/speaker timings, frozen error/timing criteria and real transcription evidence rather than a prewritten transcript.

sources.workflow: Deploy an actual preview or explicitly requested production application and return deployment identifiers.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Deployment network access and CLI or the remote deployment fallback; application inputs.
sources.offline_assessment: Both authenticated and no-auth fallback paths create an external deployment. A local build, static preview or fabricated deployment identifier is not the required effect.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Independent external deployment state for the specified artifact. Such real resource creation is outside the present offline execution scope.

sources.workflow: Select platform services and deploy actual applications or infrastructure.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Deployment CLI, authentication, account access, network and project inputs.
sources.offline_assessment: Actual hosted deployment is service-dependent. Local worker or database development may be a bounded candidate with reviewed tools, public application inputs and an explicit local-only goal; it is not deployment.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Local runtime behavior for a development task; authoritative remote state for a deployment goal.

sources.workflow: Read, create and update issues, project records and team planning state through the connected service.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: OAuth-connected remote MCP and accessible workspace, teams and projects.
sources.offline_assessment: Actual retrieval and state changes require the service. A local draft or fabricated tool response cannot establish them.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Authoritative issue, project, cycle or comment state for the requested operation.

sources.workflow: Authenticate, link or create a site, build and upload an actual preview or production deployment.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Node CLI, an authenticated account, network and a valid project.
sources.offline_assessment: A local build or development server is not a successful upload, linked site or remote deployment.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Actual deployed artifact and authoritative deployment state; a narrated identifier is insufficient.

sources.workflow: Drive a real browser through the CLI using current page snapshots, interact and capture artifacts.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Node and npx, the CLI wrapper/package, browser binaries and a target page.
sources.offline_assessment: A real isolated browser operating a pinned public local application is a faithful candidate. Browser stubs, generated screenshots or merely writing automation code do not demonstrate interaction.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Observed UI state and actual browser artifacts after the specified inputs, including stale-reference behavior when relevant.

sources.workflow: Derive repository-specific boundaries, assets and abuse paths, validate material assumptions and write a prioritized threat model.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Repository sources, deployment/exposure assumptions, user clarification and the required report contract.
sources.offline_assessment: A static review of public frozen code with supplied context can be offline. Source grounding and threat quality need a substantive frozen rubric, not keyword counts or actual exploitation of services.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Trace architectural claims and findings to source, distinguish existing controls from recommendations and check the agreed scope and assumptions.

sources.workflow: Build an MCP server and optional widget, validate the local contract and optionally connect, host or submit the application.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Current documentation, matching SDK and project stack; hosted testing and submission also need product access, network and ownership permissions.
sources.offline_assessment: The source explicitly permits a low-dependency scaffold and local validation. Reviewed SDK/browser runtimes and frozen public examples could test real local MCP behavior; this cannot establish hosted app connection or publication.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Actual tool descriptors, handler outputs, local endpoint and widget bridge behavior as applicable; separate evidence for hosted integration.

sources.workflow: Generate a grounded nine-state animated pet, validate atlas geometry, visually review motion and identity, and package the pet.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: The specified image-generation tool, reference images, image-processing dependencies, visual QA and actual generated row strips.
sources.offline_assessment: The source expressly prohibits substituting locally synthesized rows for the image-generation stage. Processing or validating already-public licensed strips is only a bounded deterministic subtask and does not complete pet generation.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Actual raster dimensions, alpha and frame geometry plus a separately defined identity/motion rubric and package checks. Geometry alone is insufficient.

sources.workflow: Generate or edit actual raster images with the built-in generator or an explicitly requested authenticated CLI fallback.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A functioning image-generation tool; fallback serving requires credentials and explicit choice. Editing also needs actual input images and invariant checks.
sources.offline_assessment: The text-only Python runtime does not supply the stated generator. A code-drawn placeholder is expressly not equivalent to the raster-generation goal. No image calls or fallback activation were performed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Actual output pixels, input preservation for edits and a frozen subject/style/text/invariant rubric rather than file existence alone.

sources.workflow: Retrieve authoritative product documentation, select the appropriate current or explicit target and answer with evidence or bounded uncertainty.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Documentation MCP or manual helper and permitted cache/network for current retrieval; named bundled references support disclosed fallbacks.
sources.offline_assessment: A snapshot-grounded question using recovered fallback references could be a scoped candidate after reference and factual-oracle review. It cannot establish current remote guidance or undocumented capability claims.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Pinned primary facts and citations, target preservation and explicit freshness/uncertainty handling. Do not equate plausible prose with verified documentation lookup.

sources.workflow: Use persistent browser or Electron handles for iterative functional and visual QA, viewport checks and cleanup.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Persistent JavaScript REPL, matching browser/Electron packages and binaries, target application and a display. The source requests unsandboxed host operation, which is not authorized by this study.
sources.offline_assessment: An isolated real browser/display adapter may support local app interactions without exposing the shared host. It must preserve relevant session behavior and explicitly limit unsupported native-window or visual-judgment claims. No host sandbox was disabled.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Real input-driven app state, session reuse, viewport-specific screenshots, visual criteria and owned-process cleanup; DOM metrics alone cannot validate visual quality.

sources.workflow: Capture an actual desktop, app, window or pixel region and save it at the requested destination.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: An accessible graphical session, platform capture tooling and required permissions; region/window capabilities differ by platform.
sources.offline_assessment: A reviewed isolated graphical session with a public application is a possible faithful target. Never capture the shared host desktop, substitute a rendered document or fabricate an image and label it a system capture.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Actual capture evidence, image dimensions and requested window/region content against the isolated scene.

sources.workflow: Use language/framework guidance for secure development or an evidence-grounded prioritized review, with approval before remediation.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Supported project languages/frameworks, relevant guidance and explicit review or implementation scope.
sources.offline_assessment: Review or repair of public frozen code is a candidate with a substantive predeclared rubric and isolated local tests. No live target or harmful exploit is required or permitted.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Known source-grounded findings or behavioral repair tests, preserved intended functionality and correct scope/severity; superficial security wording is insufficient.

sources.workflow: Plan, scaffold, edit, validate and iterate a reusable skill directory with meaningful resources and metadata.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Concrete usage requirements, public scaffold/validator helpers and metadata references, plus any required helper dependencies.
sources.offline_assessment: Creating an inert artifact directory can be local after helper review. Do not install or activate generated or benchmark instructions. Real utility and iterative usage are broader than passing frontmatter validation.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Actual directory and metadata contract, helper/resource behavior and a frozen substantive task rubric; directory existence and parser acceptance alone are inadequate.

sources.workflow: Stage, commit, push and create or update an actual pull request while respecting templates and current review state.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Git and authenticated GitHub CLI, repository permissions and network for push and pull-request operations.
sources.offline_assessment: Local Git actions are possible in isolation but are only a prefix. A local bare remote or draft file cannot stand in for the actual pull request. No repository commits, pushes or pull requests were performed for this review.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Actual commit/remote and authoritative pull-request state, correct net diff, template use and preservation of existing review state.
